Do a thorough visual and functional audit of the Driveway Mechanic site at http://localhost:4325/. Visit EVERY page and click EVERY link to verify nothing is broken.

For EACH page:
- Does it load? Any error overlays?

- Check the footer links — click each one (Car Won't Start, Check Engine Light, Oil Change Guide, Best OBD2 Scanners, Disclaimer, Affiliate Disclosure, Privacy Policy)

Report ALL issues found, no matter how minor. If everything is clean, say so explicitly.
